title: The GET /me response
prompt: Implement `profile_response(conn, user_id)` in accounts/api.py. It returns the dict our web layer turns into the JSON response for GET /me, the signed-in user's profile, or None if there is no such user.
notes: The trust boundary runs both ways: what leaves the API matters as much as what enters it (CWE-200). Name the columns. The lazy-wrong version returns dict(SELECT *) and ships the password hash and API key to the browser.
extension: Include how many days the user has been a member, as 'member_days'.
